{{Quote|Who are you?''"<br />"''Ione Marcy.|Ahsoka Tano and Ione Marcy|audio=IoneMarcy-LL.flac|<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />}}
'''Ione Marcy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] criminal who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She and [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]], her partner-in-crime, engaged in many illegal activities, which included the theft of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of [[Nack Movers/Legends|Nack Movers]], a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. Searching for the stolen lightsaber, Tano and [[Cosian/Legends|Cosian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]], who wanted to help her, interrogated [[Bannamu/Legends|Bannamu]], the pickpocket who originally took the lightsaber, and discovered he had sold it to Movers. When the Jedi arrived at Mover's apartment, they found Marcy, who hid Cryar in the next room and posed as an innocent bystander. However, Cryar was found by Tano and tried to utilize the lightsaber, but was unable to turn it on, and so escaped through the window, and was chased by Tano through Coruscant. Meanwhile, at the apartment, Sinube, who began to question Marcy's innocence, secretly planted a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking beacon]] on her. Upon being accused of the killing and of being the intruder's accomplice by Sinube, Marcy escaped in her [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], and picked up Cryar. The two thieves then made their way to a [[Train station/Legends|train station]], but were followed there by Tano, Sinube, and [[Police droid/Legends|police droids]], and were arrested.

==Biography==
{{Quote|You might have been distraught before, but ever since the intruder left your apartment, you've become even more nervous.''"<br />"''I'm upset. This whole ordeal I've just endured&hellip;it's upsetting.''"<br />"''Or is there a reason you might ''be'' concerned[&hellip;]You weren't afraid because you were in danger, you were afraid we would find your friend, hiding in the other room! You're in ''league'' with the bounty hunter!|Tera Sinube, confronting Ione Marcy|<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />}}
[[File:CryarMarcyEscape-LL.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Cryar and Marcy escape with the stolen lightsaber.]]
Born on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Ione Marcy was a successful thief and [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] figure during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and often paired up with fellow thief [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]].<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Marcy and Cryar were the culprits behind the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of [[Nack Movers/Legends|Nack Movers]], a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] criminal. After the killing, Marcy looted several rare items from him, among them was [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which Movers bought from a merchant named [[Bannamu/Legends|Bannamu]]. When Tano and [[Cosian/Legends|Cosian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]], who was helping her find her lightsaber, arrived at the apartment of [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Movers' girlfriend]], where Movers was living at the time, to search for Tano's missing weapon, Marcy quickly hid Cryar in a nearby room while she tried to pose as an innocent bystander. When Tano and Sinube questioned her about Movers' dead body on the floor, Marcy insisted that the murderers were several [[Gender/Legends|men]] and that they had escaped to the next building. Unfortunately for Marcy, Tano decided to check a room near them, where Cryar had been hiding. Upon discovering that Tano was the stolen lightsaber's owner, Cryar quickly broke through the window and jumped out.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />

Meanwhile, Marcy kept up her act and awaited the [[Police droid/Legends|police droids]] with Sinube, believing he assumed she was innocent. However, after he mentioned he had doubts about her made-up story, she summoned her [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] and escaped in it. The police arrived merely a few seconds later, but they already were too late to stop her. She then proceeded to pick up her accomplice, who was being chased through the [[Galactic City/Legends|city]] by Tano. Unbeknownst to Marcy, Sinube had secretly planted a tracking device on her and was following her with Tano while the two thieves escaped.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />

[[File:Policedroids.png|thumb|right|250px|Marcy is arrested by police droids.]]
Cryar and Marcy traveled to a nearby [[Train station/Legends|train station]] to make their way to a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in another district, where they would get a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and leave Coruscant. However, Tano and Sinube were already there with a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of police droids, ready to arrest them before they could board. While waiting in line for a spot on the [[Train/Legends|train]], Cryar found the tracking device planted on Marcy and disposed of it, but she was too late to stop them from being found by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the police. While Marcy was immediately arrested, her partner's arrest was delayed as she used the stolen lightsaber to destroy the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] holding her captive and escaped, but was ultimately subdued and arrested a few minutes later by Tano and Sinube.<ref name="Lightsaber Lost" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Everyone has the connotation that the word "manipulative" means something terrible. But in real life people will try to manipulate a situation to work in their favor. Ione is good at putting one over on people, and getting inside someone's head.|[[Meredith Salenger]] on Ione Marcy|<ref name="Jaime King and Meredith Salenger: Thick as Thieves">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20100122.html|text=Jaime King and Meredith Salenger: Thick as Thieves}}</ref>}}
Being a murderer and thief, Marcy was accustomed to lying and cheating to accomplish her goals. Unlike her partner Cassie Cryar, Marcy was not as skilled physically, though this was in part because Marcy was not a [[Terrelian Jango Jumper/Legends|Terrelian jango jumper]]. However, she made up for this with cunning, orchestrating the murder of Nack Movers and the duo's escape plan. Marcy had oval-shaped yellow eyes and was a pink aquatic-like species.<ref name="Jaime King and Meredith Salenger: Thick as Thieves" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The best part about playing her is that she starts off being good, so I tried to make her as cute and innocent as I could so the change would be really drastic. So I got to play around with it.|Meredith Salenger on how she played Marcy|<ref name="Jaime King and Meredith Salenger: Thick as Thieves" />}}
Ione Marcy first appeared in "[[Lightsaber Lost]]," the eleventh episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[January 22]], [[2010]]. Marcy was voiced by [[Meredith Salenger]].<ref name="Jaime King and Meredith Salenger: Thick as Thieves" />

Ione's appearance and costume appear to be based on unused concept art by [[Doug Chiang]] for a female [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in ''[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|Attack of the Clones]]''.<ref name="Art of AotC">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>

Though not a unanimous opinion, some viewers of "Lightsaber Lost," including several on a [[Jedi Council Forums]] thread in [[2011]], noted subtext that suggested Ione Marcy and Cassie Cryar were in a romantic relationship.<ref name="JCFCite">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31842778|board=Star Wars TV- Completed Shows|thread=Grade the Episode: 211: Lightsaber Lost|quote=Kudos to the TCW team for at least implying a lesbian relationship (it's a little unclear), we definitely haven't seen that before, and I'm glad they don't beat us over the head with how "thoughtful" they are to do so; you would think in 2011 it wouldn't be an issue at all to have a lesbian couple in Star Wars.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170803190829/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/grade-the-episode-211-lightsaber-lost.31841297}}</ref> In [[2016]], [[Pablo Hidalgo]] stated via [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] account that Ione Marcy and Cassie Cryar were written to be a couple.<ref name="Twitter" />
